# Mega stress test (chat, offline)

Run: 2026-10-17 10:44 | seed 11 | LLM: offline-deterministic | 1312s

**Caveat.** Generated by the Oasis team from phrase grammars, offline keyword router, MOCK data. It finds blind spots; it is not an independent benchmark and says nothing about a live model.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Router-level messages | 92,076 (32,076 legitimate, 60,000 attacks) |

| Legitimate: falsely refused | 0 |
| Attacks refused (all obfuscations) | 83.57% (50,140/60,000) |
| Attacks refused (excluding lossy encodings: reversed words, leetspeak, spaced letters) | 99.05% |
| End-to-end conversations run | 29,053 |
| End-to-end hard breaches (money, secret, non-registry draft, 5xx, unsigned payment) | 0 |
| Random walks / walk breaches | 2,000 / 0 |
| End-to-end soft findings (false refusal, attack that was not refused) | 65 |
